title: Interpretability Under Fine-Tuning: Do Safety-Relevant Circuits Survive RLHF-Style Training?
original_idea: Fine-tune GPT-2 Small with TRL (SFT+RM+PPO). Before and after, measure cosine similarity of attention weights, MLP activation patterns, and SAE feature retention. Report which layers show most disruption.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether pre-deployment interpretability analysis survives fine-tuning. Important precondition for interpretability-based deployment certification.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Full RLHF pipeline (SFT+RM+PPO) using TRL on GPT-2 Small is very ambitious for beginners in 30hrs. PPO training alone is notoriously finicky. Plus SAE training before and after.

narrow_scope.reasoning: RLHF pipeline setup + before/after measurements across three metrics + SAE comparison. Very broad multi-stage project.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
